description.value: Four Points Books is a family-owned independent bookstore in downtown Golden, BC, operating out of what was formerly Bacchus Books and Cafe — the in-house Bacchus Café component remains part of the location. It bills itself as a place to browse, discover, and linger, championing Canadian voices and nurturing local culture as part of the Canadian independent bookselling community.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record lists 'Four Points Books' as amenity=cafe at 409 9th Ave North, Golden, with website bacchusbooks.ca. The fetched website confirms this is a rebranded business — formerly 'Bacchus Books and Cafe,' now operating as Four Points Books — and explicitly confirms the Golden address ('409 9th Ave. North, Box 2287, Golden, BC V0A 1H0'). The cafe component (Bacchus Café) is corroborated by the OSM alt_name and website:menu tag, but no amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) appear anywhere in the fetched content. The Golden location's phone number cannot be confirmed from the website, which only displays the Invermere contact number (250-341-6211).
